products.name: KUSHI Bee Venom Serum, Natural Firming Collagen Face Serum, 0.5 fl oz | Cruelty-free hydrating & firming bee venom face serum with Manuka honey, royal jelly, propolis, jojoba oil
specs: Natural Firming Serum: This lightweight face serum blends 0.5% bee venom with manuka honey, royal jelly, propolis, and jojoba oil for a natural approach to firmer, smoother looking skin.

Bee Venom Skin Restoration: Bee venom gently stimulates natural collagen and elastin production, without injections, to improve skin firmness and reduce wrinkles and fine lines. It also helps increase circulation for a plump youthful glow.

Tightens & Smooths: Regular use helps improve the look of elasticity and the appearance of fine lines, leaving skin feeling lifted, sculpted, and smoother over time. Propolis and royal jelly provide soothing effects, reducing redness and irritation.

For Daily Use On All Skin Types: Apply a few drops of bee venom face serum to clean, dry skin once daily, avoiding the eye area. Patch test before first use, especially if you have sensitive skin. *CONTAINS BEE VENOM. DO NOT USE IF ALLERGIC TO BEES.*

Clean Ingredient List: Free from fragrance, parabens, phthalates, and sulfates, and made without GMOs. Manuka honey and propolis add antioxidants. Bee venom is collected using humane methods that do not harm the bees.

products.name: Bee Venom Face Serum - Niacinamide & Propolis Firming Lifting Peptide 30ml | Bee venom, dual peptides and niacinamide in a fast-absorbing 30 ml serum for the look of firmer, smoother skin.
specs: FIRMING BEE VENOM FACE SERUM: A lightweight daily serum built on bee venom plus two peptides - acetyl hexapeptide-8 and arginine/lysine polypeptide. It sinks in fast with no greasy film, so it layers cleanly under moisturizer, sunscreen or makeup without pilling or rolling.

DUAL PEPTIDE + NIACINAMIDE: Acetyl hexapeptide-8 is a topical peptide used to soften the look of expression lines. Arginine/lysine polypeptide supports the look of skin density, and niacinamide helps even the look of skin tone and refine the look of texture, so skin looks smoother and more uniform with daily use. No needles, no downtime.

PROPOLIS + SODIUM HYALURONATE + PANTHENOL: Propolis, sodium hyaluronate and panthenol carry the moisture side of the formula, while centella asiatica and allantoin help comfort the look of stressed skin. The humectant base keeps skin feeling supple instead of tight - a fit for dry, normal and combination skin that wants firmness without a heavy cream.

FACE, NECK AND DECOLLETE ROUTINE: Apply 3-4 drops to clean, dry skin morning and night, pressing gently upward along the jawline and cheekbones, then follow with moisturizer. One 30 ml bottle lasts about six weeks at twice-daily use - enough to judge results without running out mid-routine.

GENTLE DAILY USE: Patch test on the inner arm 24 hours before first use and stop if irritation occurs. For external use only; avoid contact with eyes. Do not use if you are allergic to bee venom, propolis or other bee-derived ingredients. Store sealed, away from direct sunlight.
